subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should the Groq TPM failure be owned by this narrow Groq-specific recovery or by the broader implicit-output-reservation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same released bug at different ownership boundaries and should not land together; repository policy favors provider-owned vendor behavior unless maintainers intentionally want a shared transport contract change.

options.title: Choose Groq-scoped recovery
options.body: Repair the no-tool eligibility gap in this PR and keep successful request behavior unchanged for other providers.

options.title: Choose shared transport policy
options.body: Pause this PR and select the broader alternative only after equivalent live-provider and cross-provider upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Choose Groq-scoped recovery
recommendation.body: Repair the no-tool eligibility gap in this PR and keep successful request behavior unchanged for other providers.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the current Groq entrypoint and recently worked on the plugin SDK provider surface where this ownership choice lands.
